tests.name: join_and_replication
tests.details: Two simultaneous real clients; equal stats; 3s countdown; exact same-tick snapshots; no token leakage

tests.name: two_player_capacity
tests.details: A third player is rejected with arena_full

tests.name: authoritative_movement_and_forgery
tests.details: Movement obeys 4.5m/s (1.350m sampled); forged HP/wins/damage ignored; remote movement matches

tests.name: malformed_and_finite_validation
tests.details: Non-numeric/null/bool/infinite coordinates, malformed JSON and binary frames rejected; session survives

tests.name: melee_and_cooldown
tests.details: Range-gated 14 damage replicated to both clients; rapid second strike rejected; mutual combat works

tests.name: telegraph_and_projectile
tests.details: 0.4s readable telegraph precedes travelling bolt; 24 damage shared; forged damage ignored; 3s cooldown enforced

tests.name: dash_distance_and_cooldown
tests.details: Server performs exactly 3m burst in 0.18s; dashing state replicated; immediate second dash rejected

tests.name: arena_bounds
tests.details: Oversized finite destination clamps to (+10,+7); no teleport or escape

tests.name: knockout_exactly_once
tests.details: Lethal hit ends round once; winner replicated; wins increments exactly once; post-round attacks rejected

tests.name: mutual_ready_rematch
tests.details: One ready does not restart; both ready resets HP/cooldowns; ends swap for fairness; round increments

tests.name: dash_invulnerability
tests.details: An in-range melee strike during a replicated dash is dodged; HP unchanged

tests.name: disconnect_pause_and_reconnect
tests.details: Disconnect freezes combat/movement; same in-memory token resumes slot and round within 6s; identity and score retained

tests.name: connected_token_protection
tests.details: An active player cannot be replaced by a second connection using its token

tests.name: disconnect_forfeit_and_score_resume
tests.details: 6s disconnect forfeits exactly once; reconnect retains finished round and accumulated score

tests.name: packet_size_limit
tests.details: A >1024-byte JSON packet is rejected and closed

tests.name: bounded_message_rate
tests.details: 100-message flood is disconnected by queue/rate bounds; existing arena stays responsive

tests.name: simulation_and_snapshot_cadence
tests.details: Measured 20.02 simulation ticks/s and one public snapshot per 2 ticks (~10Hz)

stability.evidence_scope: protocol and simulated application packet drain; not visual proof

tests.name: legacy_snapshot_backlog_control
tests.details: No recv/commands for 14.002s produced 139 queued snapshots, exceeding the 128-packet browser limit

tests.name: native_legacy_packet_queue_saturation
tests.details: Native WebSocketPeer saturated its 128-packet queue during 14.005s and then replayed 140 snapshots; native transport remained open, so this is not the Web overflow error

native_result.reason: Native queue saturated and replayed stale snapshots

tests.name: native_ack_queue_stall_recovery
tests.details: Native WebSocketPeer with max_queued_packets=128 held exactly one packet for 32.005s, then recovered 640 ticks forward

native_result.reason: ACK queue remained bounded and resumed at current state

tests.name: negotiated_snapshot_backpressure
tests.details: 32.001s without recv/commands queued exactly one snapshot; consuming without ACK kept gate closed; ACK jumped 648 ticks to current state in 0.092s

tests.name: invalid_ack_cannot_unlock_or_corrupt
tests.details: 13 malformed/future/stale/replayed ACK variants kept one snapshot in flight; exact ACK alone released the next fresh snapshot; state unchanged

tests.name: ack_reconnect_and_damage_authority
tests.details: Reconnect with an unacknowledged old snapshot reset flow control, retained identity/86 HP, and resumed combat; forged damage dealt only 14, double attack hit cooldown, forged state and boolean movement changed nothing

tests.name: real_sixty_second_session_expiry
tests.details: Slot remained reserved at 58s and expired after 60.080s; old token rejected, new ID/token admitted with 100 HP/0 wins, survivor score retained and next round started

browser_gate: Required on exact commit before rollout; separate CI artifact
